payload.title: File:States of Zhou Dynasty.png
payload.description_html: Map showing many of the ancient Chinese states (國, guo) at an indeterminate time under the Eastern Zhou dynasty with a nonsense "Principality State" label above. Borders are approximate and many locations are misplaced relative to the rivers and approximate coastline. Avoid use.
